content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to take three analog inputs, compare them, and use only the highest value as an output?
I have attached a potential solution. The three analog values are compared, and the highest value is selected and output.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for a way to compare three analog inputs and output the highest value using [product_name] from [company_name]. Another member provided a solution that shows this is possible, even if not directly available as a built-in feature. The exchange confirms that the product can achieve the desired logic using available functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the product to support easy comparison of multiple analog signals and automated output of the maximum value, preferably as a straightforward or standard option.
